screens.accessibility: Implement WCAG 2.2 AA semantics, keyboard behavior, focus, contrast, reflow, and announcements.
screens.content_constraints: Support translated, empty, error, permission, and extreme-length content without overlap.
screens.responsive_behavior: Preserve list context and reachable actions at every declared breakpoint.

screens.accessibility: Expose semantic headings, timeline landmarks, keyboard navigation, and announced status changes.
screens.content_constraints: Long checkpoint names and failure details wrap without shifting the primary action.
screens.responsive_behavior: Collapse secondary metadata while retaining the current run and next action.

screens.accessibility: Keep decision controls keyboard reachable and provide explicit stale and forbidden feedback.
screens.content_constraints: Evidence metadata and decision reasons remain readable at extreme lengths.
screens.responsive_behavior: Render the approval drawer as a full-height mobile panel below 768px.

screens.accessibility: Use a semantic evidence table and provide redaction and classification notices.
screens.content_constraints: Paths remain repository-relative and hashes do not overflow their cells.
screens.responsive_behavior: Allow horizontal table inspection without hiding classification or receipt state.
